name: Being Engaged
overview: Scripture calls believers to live holy and sacrificial lives, presenting themselves as living sacrifices to God (Romans 12:1). In the context of relationships, the Bible emphasizes the sanctity of marriage, instructing husbands to love their wives sacrificially as Christ loved the church (Ephesians 5:25) and urging wives to respect their husbands (Ephesians 5:33). The Word also clearly condemns sexual immorality, including adultery and fornication (Galatians 5:19), and upholds God's standards for sexual behavior (Leviticus 20:13). At the heart of these commands is the call to live in a way that honors God's love and redemption through Christ (John 3:16).
